0022600187.text: The Orlando Magic (2-5, 2-1 on the road, 0-4 at home, on a two-game losing streak and 11th in the East) visit the Phoenix Suns (1-4, 0-3 on the road, 1-1 at home, on a three-game losing streak and 12th in the West) for Orlando's eighth game of the season. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), while Anthony Black is day-to-day with a rest designation and is a game-time decision, and Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their two meetings in 2025-26, with the Magic winning the most recent one 115-111 in Orlando on March 31, 2026.
